name: Kadife Gül
scene: a full rose with layered petals, a stem and two leaves
notes: Rose blossom uses the subject pair; stem, two leaves and surrounding divisions use the background pair. Target 38–48 panes. Visually inspected both generations; selected retry improves leaf colour alternation and simplifies the centre. Remaining doubts: subtle tonal variation persists, some adjacent petals share a colour, several petal tips and leaf junctions are narrow/crowded, and total visible divisions may exceed target before tracing/merging. No obvious loose line ends; geometric contact audit has not been performed. Design sheet only.
prompt:
Create a flat stained-glass puzzle DESIGN SHEET, not finished glass. Portrait 3:4 canvas. Single elegant full rose with layered curved petals, one stem and two leaves, in an oval panel nearly touching canvas edges with pure white exterior. Reference 1 is only the old subject idea; replace its concentric cartoon geometry completely. Reference 2 is the desired elegant botanical leaded-panel design language, but use perfectly flat fills, no shading. Aim for 38–48 closed substantial panes total (about 22 rose petals and 20 supporting/background panes). A rich natural rose bloom fills upper two thirds, softly spiralling overlapping broad petals, graceful stem and two large pointed leaves below. Exactly FOUR flat colours: crimson #B82750 and coral #EF8290 for the rose flower only; emerald #28785C and turquoise #59B5BC for all background, stem and leaves. Alternate crimson/coral neighbouring flower pieces; alternate emerald/turquoise background pieces as far as possible, never use flower colours in background. Leaves and stem count as botanical background, not flower. Black uniform smooth lead about 1 percent of canvas width, closed thick black oval rim. Every lead line ends at another line or rim, only spaced T junctions, no X/four-way contacts, no loose lines, no tiny pieces, no slivers, no nearly parallel narrow gaps. Petals should be graceful broad true rose petal shapes, not concentric circles, not a generic geometric rosette. All pieces flat solid colour. No white inside panel, no gradients, glass texture, highlights, shadows, speckles, text, frame, labels or signature. Output just one finished design image.
REVISION: Simplify to approximately 42 panes total. Absolutely flat vector-style fills, NO lighting and NO subtle gradients whatsoever. Reduce petals to 18 broad curved pieces with a simple 3-piece rose centre; avoid crowded tiny central pieces. Use about 24 large surrounding pieces including stem and leaves. Alternate green and turquoise INSIDE the leaves too, rather than every leaf piece green. Same-colour adjacent petals should be merged by removing their separator. Separate all junctions, never four lines meeting. All internal lead the same bold thickness. Keep the elegant realistic rose silhouette.
